summary: Iteration 4 frontend regression + visual redesign verification for Config Management (/config-management) and Platform Admin (/admin, /admin/tenants/[id], /admin/devices, /admin/settings). Login as admin/admin123 lands on dashboard. All redesigned pages render correctly with the cyan/indigo glass design system and all functional flows work end-to-end. Full policy CRUD, tenant creation, tenant detail (device + user + branding save), device reassignment, and platform settings save flows all pass. Overview / and /bgp-peers regressions still load.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid attributes on Platform Admin pages (create-tenant-btn, tenant row Kelola/Hapus, assign-btn, save-platform-settings) — currently Playwright works fine via placeholders/text but testids would harden future tests. Not blocking.

Pre-existing (from iter 3, still present): SSR hydration mismatch on dashboard 'Since:' timestamp titles (server 'YYYY-MM-DD h:mm:ss' vs client 'M/D/YYYY, h:mm:ss') — visible as red console error on /. Not related to this iteration's redesign but should be fixed by formatting deterministically or using suppressHydrationWarning.

Pre-existing: React warning 'Encountered two children with the same key: lab-1-198.51.100.7 / lab-1-203.0.113.10' on / dashboard. Key generation in the sessions table needs to be unique (e.g., include peer id, not just device-ip). Non-blocking but noisy.
Pre-existing dev-only: webpack-hmr WebSocket 502 through ingress — harmless in preview.
critical_code_review_comments: Config Management redesign is clean and consistent with the cyan/indigo glass system; all critical testids (config-tab-*, trigger-backup-btn, policies-table, new-policy-btn, policy-modal, policy-name, policy-regex, save-policy, edit-policy-<id>, delete-policy-<id>) are wired correctly.

Platform Admin redesign looks good visually (glass header, superadmin badge, user dropdown, cyan stat cards, gradient buttons). Consider adding data-testid on the Create Tenant button and tenant row action buttons for testability.
Two duplicate-key React warnings on the dashboard sessions table still present — should be RCA'd (likely mapping over sessions grouped by device without a stable secondary key).
Hydration mismatch on 'Since:' timestamp title carries over from previous iteration.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_org_<timestamp> tenant + orgadmin user + TEST_pol_<timestamp> policy during test; all cleaned up at end (tenant deleted, device reassigned back to Platform Admin, policy deleted). Final DB state matches pre-test baseline: 1 tenant (Platform Admin), 1 device (lab-router-01), 0 policies.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 visual redesign of Config Management and Platform Admin fully verified — no functional regressions.
